name: kept-ai
description: Kept AI: an AI Knowledge Inbox built for the Turium AI Full Stack Developer assessment

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npx -w client tsc -b
